verdict.rationale: Docs describe the same folder/SKILL.md format (name+description, optional scripts/references) used elsewhere, and explicitly cover migrating Claude Code plugins/connectors to Codex, implying cross-vendor portability; community commentary also treats 'Claude Skills' and Codex Skills as the same artifact. However, no evidence explicitly cites or asserts conformance to a named open 'Agent Skills specification' standard. Missing for 10: an explicit reference to the open Agent Skills spec/versioned schema, and independent confirmation that a skill folder authored for Codex works unmodified in another vendor's tool.
